player_prompt.intro:
U dyondza 2048 eka bhodi leyi {board_size}x{board_size}. Vuswona bya wena i ku fikela tile ya {target_tile} hi ku sweka swihlala swa namuntlha swi va kona!
Vutivi bya vunanga: [Up], [Down], [Left], [Right]. Tiles ti sungula hi ku va kona loko ti kongomisa, ti baleka namuntlha wati va yona.

invalid_move.no_change: Board did not change - choose a different direction.

outcome.win: Kutlhariwa, u fikile {target_tile}! Skor ya mahala {score}.
outcome.lose: Ku hela timosve. Max tile {max_tile} - skor ya mahala {score}.
